decision_policy: Earliest eligible kb3 decision per ticker, selected before label join; 0 < time to close <= 12 minutes; quote received <= decision, age <= 120 seconds.
pricing: Observed YES ask and NO ask only; never complement the opposite ask. Canonical one-contract fee.
estimand: Model minus same-window market-favorite P&L in cents per eligible window; both abstain when the model gate does not fire. Chronological moving-block bootstrap (block 10, seed 0).
inference: Descriptive six-margin sweep, unadjusted for multiple comparisons; not sealed-test qualification or evidence of a verified trading edge.
archive_policy: Immutable earliest observed decisions; conflicting or earlier rediscovered evidence blocks a window. Rolling-log deletion never deletes archived evidence.
